description: Use when an agent needs the readable text of a web page as markdown. Returns the main content of the one URL you pass as clean markdown (Mozilla Readability, then turndown), with title, final URL, fetch time and word count. http or https on ports 80 and 443, 5 MB, 10 s; robots.txt honoured and private addresses refused. A blocked or unreachable URL is never charged. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

url.description: the page to convert: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_web_markdown

data.description: the get_web_markdown payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_web_markdown

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Web page to markdown
